payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning'. The post gives no figures by decision, so the commercial question peaks where the reader realises a wedding abroad means many suppliers and contracts at once: the end of the destination section (primary), and again after the quote comparison checklist, just before signing (secondary). The closing CTA ends the post and the magazine serves readers still collecting ideas. Per the panel, 'payments' was dropped and accountability rests on inclusions confirmed in writing, so the primary subtext uses that line. Subtexts use only brand-facts lines 25, 26, 28 and 30: single point of contact, start to finish, time zone, inclusions confirmed in writing, and venue, travel and vendors. All money, rate, currency, payment and booking-status wording is left out, matching the panel's deferred list. A printable photographer quote comparison checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
